paperInfo.subject: Biology
paperInfo.copyrightNote: Original practice questions synthesized from syllabus/specimen structure and recurring examination themes; not verbatim copies of copyrighted past papers.

questions.questionText: Cell biology: A-level structured problem. Describe the relevant biological process, explain the mechanisms involved, analyse the factors affecting it, and evaluate how experimental evidence could be used to support a conclusion. Where appropriate, include labelled diagrams, calculations, controls and limitations.
questions.explanation: A strong response should use accurate biological terminology, linked explanations, relevant evidence, appropriate calculations or diagrams, and evaluation of limitations.
